@@note: Italiano: traduzione automatica, non ancora rivista da un madrelingua. Fatta dalle traduzioni dell'app mobile (mstream_music, lib/l10n/app_it.arb, master bdb174e, GPL-3.0) e del lettore da terminale (mstream-terminal-player, locales/it.yml, main b89ad0a, GPL-3.0-only), dello stesso autore, dove avevano il testo o le parole (termini, registro 'tu', tipografia); il resto lo ha tradotto un agente Fable (Claude), e un secondo agente lo ha riletto. Machine translation: made from the mobile app's and the terminal player's translations where they had the text, and translated by a Fable agent otherwise, then reviewed by a second Fable agent; not yet reviewed by a native speaker. The rooms the notes give are those the texts were fitted to (42356b7); the layout fixes since gave most buttons and pills 2-4 px more and Small when their font doesn't fit, so a few of the apps' words a note set aside would fit now (docs/I18N.md, phase 3, lists them for a native review). The Auto DJ texts (October 2026, the engine's UI: toast.autodj_*, now_playing.autodj*, library.autodj_here, empty.autodj, output.autodj*, autodj.*) were made the same way: the mobile app's words for Auto DJ, Ancora, Segui l’atmosfera, brano di partenza, Soglia di somiglianza, Continuità dei BPM and Mixaggio armonico (its autoDj* keys), translated by a Fable agent otherwise, fitted to en.json's rooms (the notes say where a room made a text shorter), not yet reviewed by a native speaker.
